skills.detail:
When there is a Treasure Area: Unleashes an area attack on enemies in the nearest Treasure Area that deals a fixed percentage of damage with a Knockback effect. Creates a shield in the nearest Treasure Area that blocks enemies' attacks and movement.

When there is no Treasure Area: Unleashes a mid-range area attack that deals a fixed percentage of damage with a Knockback effect. Creates a shield that blocks close-range enemies' attacks and movement.

The shield will disappear after it receives a certain amount of damage or after a certain amount of time passes. Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP. This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: I'll Trick You

skills.detail:
A mid-range attack that deals percentage damage with a chance to inflict Sing-Sing state.
Unleashes a close-range attack that deals a fixed percentage of damage while the skill button is held down. Each time a fixed period of time passes, sweets are created at close range.
If you or an ally touches a sweet, it will restore HP.
The sweets will disappear after they are touched or after a certain amount of time passes.

The attack ends after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released.

You are able to move while holding down the skill button.
Reduces damage received from enemies while the skill button is held down.
Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP.
This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
